data.name: Bhunesh
data.gender_notes: Bhunesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhunesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Bhuna’, meaning ‘to create’ or ‘to rule’, and ‘Ish’, meaning ‘God’ or ‘Lord’. The name signifies the one who creates or rules the universe. The name Bhunesh carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhunesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine creator.
data.etymology: Bhunesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhunesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
